text:
ci-bot: Nightly perf CI alert — small-batch median token latency +8.3% vs baseline on main-nightly (build: 2026.03.16-4). See dashboard: https://grafana.redwood-internal/perf/nightly?run=2026.03.16-4 :warning:

alex: Ack. Thanks for the ping. Can someone grab the bench artifacts + flamegraphs and drop them here?

maria: On it. Uploading now. Quick note: noise looks concentrated at seqlen 32-64.

maria: artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood-internal/ci/2026.03.16-4/{flamegraph,pprof}.svg and https://artifacts.redwood-internal/ci/2026.03.16-4/bench-summary.json

priya: Copy. I'll start a local bisect against the nightly window. Repro command I'm using:
```
./tools/run_bench --suite small_batch --config ci/nightly --build 2026.03.16-4 --record-trace --pprof out.pprof
```
Will post flamegraphs for each candidate.

sam: Any PRs touching batching, kernel selection, or KV cache landed before that build?

jordan: FYI PR #3412 modified KV-cache serialization path (landed ~6h before the run). Not sure it would affect token latency but flagging.

alex: Ok — plan: @maria collect artifacts (done), @priya run bisect, @sam review #3412 for perf smells. I'll create a perf-triage doc and link it here.

deploy-bot: Canary routing paused for model-serving cluster while triage is ongoing :no_entry: (actioned by @alex)

ci-bot: Update: rerun at 03:12 shows same +7.9% median delta, 95p also up. Tagging release-eng.

maria: Uploaded full traces and a small diff of seqlen distribution: https://artifacts.redwood-internal/ci/2026.03.16-4/seqlen-diff.png

priya: Bisect started. First suspect commit from bisect: commit 9a8f2b7 (changes to allocator hot path). I'll profile that one next (~20–30m).

sam: Taking a quick look at #3412 — nit: extra memcpy in serialize path, I'll do a micro-bench and post results.

alex: Thanks. Keep updates short here. If we confirm a regression from a release PR we should prepare a fast rollback or a perf patch to land. If anyone needs a quick huddle ping :phone: and I can join.

priya: Quick note — when bisecting, use `--seed 42` to stabilize scheduling noise across runs.

maria: Flamegraph attached (first pass): https://artifacts.redwood-internal/ci/2026.03.16-4/flamegraph.svg

ci-bot: tagging @release-eng @infra-alerts for visibility

alex: Great work. We'll reconvene after priya posts the bisect result or if sam finds a smoking gun in #3412.
